objective: Prove one supported node-root host resource and machine lifecycle with current attestation/enforcement, recovery, and cleanup; HYPERVISOROS_SINGLE_NODE_VIRTUALIZATION_JOURNEY_EXIT=0.
falsifiable_claim: A node image cannot complete the selected ordinary machine lifecycle under daemon-root admission.

canon_snapshot.snapshot_role: Provenance for the canon revision this record was authored against. Drift detection is owned by generated/canon-baseline.v1.json via tools/canon-impact.mjs.

required_work: Run the selected node-root machine journey on supported physical hardware.
positive_proof: One physical node completes the selected lifecycle.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: Boot, storage, network, VMM, update, and recovery faults retain exact state.

external_gates.condition: One supported hardware profile and measured-boot producer are selected.

remaining_nonclaims: Single-node proof does not imply clustered replacement.
rollback_or_stop_rule: Remain inactive until its external gates and dependencies close.
